observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with two controllers on top: one silver and one camouflage-patterned.
The console has 'SONY' and 'PS4' branding visible on the front.
The controllers appear to be DualShock 4 models, with the camouflage one having a custom design.
Photo 1 is a similar angle, showing the same console and controllers from a slightly different perspective.
The console is placed on a wooden surface with artificial grass visible in the background.
No games, cables, or other accessories are visible in either photo.
The seller claims the console is 'hacked with fc26 and 10 other interesting games' and includes 'one original pad'.

claims.claim: PlayStation 4 pro hacked with fc26 and 10 other interesting games
claims.evidence: No screen or interface is shown to confirm the hack or installed games. The console's software cannot be verified remotely.
Only two controllers are shown in the photos. The seller claims one original pad, but none is visible. The camouflage controller may be a custom or non-original pad.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be hacked or may be a non-hacked unit
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting up and displaying the home screen, or a screenshot of the system settings showing the hacked firmware version.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard, non-hacked PS4 console

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-original or damaged
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the controllers showing the model numbers and condition, or a video of them being used.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used controllers with unknown condition

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be pirated
risks.proof: Screenshots of the game library or a video showing the games being launched.

risks.risk: Console may have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, power, cooling)
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting, and playing a game.

proof_requests: Video or screenshot showing the console booting up and displaying the home screen.
Screenshots of the game library or video of games being launched.
Close-up photos of the controllers showing model numbers and condition.
Video of the console powering on and playing a game.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
